theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Kushner, Iger Buy Lakers for Record-Breaking $12.5 Billion
top_news.summary: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger are buying the Los Angeles Lakers basketball team for a record-breaking price of $12.5 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. Randall Williams has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Indonesian Tech Firm GoTo Cut From MSCI Indexes in Review
top_news.summary: MSCI Inc. removed GoTo Group from its indexes after a plunge in the Indonesian tech company’s share price left the stock difficult to trade.

top_news.title: Singer Vehicle Founder on Louis Vuitton Partnership
top_news.summary: In a groundbreaking collaboration, luxury fashion house Louis Vuitton and high-end automotive restoration company Singer have teamed up to create custom Porsche cars. This marks a first for both brands, as Louis Vuitton has never engaged in co-branding before, and Singer has not previously partnered on such a project. Rob Dickinson & Mazen Fawaz speak with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Former CDC Official on the Cyclospora Outbreak
top_news.summary: Dr. Debra Houry, Former Deputy Director for Program & Science at the CDC, discusses the ongoing cyclospora outbreak amid conflicting messages from health authorities. While the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) declared the outbreak contained and stated that salad is safe to eat, CDC data through August 11 shows a 33% increase in confirmed cases, with nearly 14,000 reported and an additional 10,000 cases still under investigation. top_news.title: Rio Tinto Aluminum Smelter Gets $1.8 Billion Australian Bailout
top_news.summary: The owners of Australia’s biggest aluminum smelter, including Rio Tinto Group, have secured a government bailout of A$2.5 billion ($1.8 billion) to keep the plant operating as it grapples with high energy costs.

top_news.title: US Regulator Denies Egan-Jones Bid to Expand Ratings Business
top_news.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission rejected credit rating firm Egan-Jones Ratings Co.’s application to re-enter the market for grading government debt and asset-backed securities, the latest sign of regulatory pushback against the small but prolific agency.

top_news.title: EM Currencies Trade Mixed as Inflation Fails to Shift Fed Bets
top_news.summary: An early rally in emerging-market currencies fizzled on Wednesday after the dollar reversed losses triggered by tame US inflation data, as investors maintained bets that the Federal Reserve could raise interest rates at its next meeting.

top_news.title: QTS Holds Calls Ahead of Possible $2.85 Billion Bond Sale
top_news.summary: Subsidiaries of QualityTech LP are holding fixed income investor calls ahead of a potential bond offering that may raise about $2.85 billion in the market’s latest data-center financing.

top_news.title: Lakers Sold, Paramount Fight, 'Daddy' Podcast | Bloomberg Deals 8/12/2026
top_news.summary: A weekly, midday program that delivers high-impact, editorially driven coverage of the most important corporate transactions shaping the global market. Today's guests: Evercore Global Head of Private Capital Nigel Dawn, Ancora Advisors President James Chadwick, Angel City Football Club Co-Founder & Monarch Collective Co-Founder Kara Nortman, and Bruin Capital CEO & Founder George Pyne.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Yen Trades Near 160 Level as Traders Watch for Intervention
top_news.summary: The yen edged closer to the key level of 160 per dollar on Wednesday, keeping investors on the lookout for more intervention by officials in the foreign-exchange market.
